blocks.text: We collect personal information voluntarily provided by users in two primary contexts: **Creators** and **Brands**.
The types of information we may collect include:
1.1 From Creators
When a Creator registers or submits a form on the Platform, we collect:

items: Full name and photograph
Age of the creator
Content niche or category
Social media links (TikTok, Instagram, etc.)
Portfolio links or video samples
Self-written biography or description
E-mail address

blocks.text: 1.2 From Brands
When a Brand registers or purchases access to the Creator Catalog, we collect:

items: Business name
Representative name and contact details (e-mail, phone)
Company website or social media links
Campaign details or creative requirements (optional)

blocks.text: 1.3 Automatically Collected Data
When you visit our website, we may automatically collect:

items: IP address and device information
Browser type and version
Pages visited, timestamps, and referring URLs
General geographic location (city, state, country)

blocks.text: This data is used for analytics, security, and platform optimization purposes only.
We use the collected data solely for legitimate business purposes, including to:

items: Operate and maintain the Platform
Create and manage user accounts
Display Creator profiles in the private catalog accessible only to verified, paying Brands
Communicate with users about campaigns, opportunities, or updates
Verify identities and ensure the integrity of user submissions
Provide customer support and respond to inquiries
Improve our services and user experience
Enforce our Terms and comply with legal obligations

blocks.text: We do not sell, rent, or trade user data to third parties.
By providing your e-mail address, you consent to receive:

items: Notifications about new brand opportunities and collaborations
Platform updates or community news
Transactional messages related to your account

blocks.text: You can opt out at any time by clicking “unsubscribe” in our e-mails or by contacting {{contactEmail}}.
Even if you opt out, we may still send non-promotional messages regarding your account or legal notices.
4.1 Creator Catalog
Creator profiles are visible only to verified Brands who have purchased access.
General visitors and the public cannot view Creator data.
Brands are contractually prohibited from copying, reselling, or sharing Creator information.
4.2 Third-Party Service Providers
We may use third-party vendors (e.g., hosting, analytics, payment processors) to support our operations.
These providers only access data necessary to perform their functions and are bound by confidentiality obligations.
4.3 Legal Requirements
We may disclose information if required by law, subpoena, or government request, or to protect our legal rights, users, or the public.
We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy or as required by law.
In general:

items: Creator and Brand data are retained while the account is active
If an account remains inactive for more than 24 months, data may be archived or deleted
Users may request deletion of their data at any time (see Section 8)

blocks.text: We implement reasonable physical, electronic, and administrative safeguards to protect personal information against loss, misuse, or unauthorized access.
Access to personal data is limited to authorized personnel who require it for legitimate business purposes.
However, no online platform can guarantee absolute security, and you use the Platform at your own risk.
The Platform is intended for users aged 18 and older.
We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18 years old.
If you believe we have inadvertently collected such information, please contact us, and we will promptly delete it.

sections.title: 8. Your Rights (Florida Digital Bill of Rights)

blocks.text: Under the **Florida Digital Bill of Rights (FDBR)**, you have the right to:

items: Access the personal information we hold about you
Delete your personal data
Correct inaccurate information
Opt out of targeted advertising or data sharing
Receive a copy of your data in a portable format

blocks.text: To exercise these rights, contact us at {{contactEmail}}.
We may require reasonable verification of your identity before fulfilling your request.
Although the Platform is primarily intended for users in the United States, data may be processed in or transferred to other jurisdictions where our service providers operate.
By using the Platform, you consent to such transfers, which will occur in compliance with applicable data-protection standards.
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
When we do, we will revise the “Last Updated” date at the top of this page.
Significant changes will be communicated via e-mail or platform notice.
Your continued use of the Platform after updates constitutes your acceptance of the revised Policy.
For any questions, concerns, or requests related to this Privacy Policy, please contact:
